name: Donchain Ch Upper
description: This keyword returns the Donchain Upper channel value. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Donchain Upper channel value. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632136228.png)

The above condition is checking if Previous day(-1) Don chain upper value is greater than the previous to previous day value (-2)

Donchian Channels are three lines generated by moving average calculations that comprise an indicator formed by upper and lower bands around a midrange or median band.

Read more about  Donchian Channels  here -  https://www.investopedia.com/terms/d/donchianchannels.asp
